high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Jamie Wang. The post includes a question about the potential damage if the Chinese Three Gorges Dam cannot cope with floods and collapses. The text reads: "How much damage will occur if the Chinese Three Gorges Dam cannot cope with the latest floods and collapses? Three Gorges dam is a gravity dam, and it doesn't collapse. What you think which would collapse is arch dam." Below the text, there is an image of a large concrete gravity dam. The dam is situated in a mountainous area, with water on one side and a steep slope on the other.
